title: Focus jumps out of Vbox/Hbox/grid containers causing accessibility issues. Container siblings should always be focus neighbors
body:
### Tested versions

-Became issue in 4.4 with addition of AccessKit integration

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9159) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

If you are in a directional container focused on child and you press the arrow key going along with the direction, right for HBOX container, down for VBOX container. the expectation is to go to to the next focusable child. Instead it will often jump out of the list. 

While  you can fix this by using code like this in your container( I run the games for blind gamers jam and had to give this out a good amount) the Godot UI also does it, so is a major problem for people using screen readers. I made an addon that auto adds similar code to each container in the UI to help blind devs out during the jam, but there isn't a clean solution since this requires something constantly checking if a new container was added, then adding a script. 

```
extends HBoxContainer
#Redoes focus whenever a reorganization happens
var children

func attach():
	sort_children.connect(gmap_children_sort)
	

func gmap_children_sort():
	children = find_window(self)
	var c = 0
	for t in children:
		if c != 0:
			t.set_focus_neighbor(0,children[c-1].get_path())  
		if c != children.size() -1:
			t.set_focus_neighbor(2,children[c+1].get_path())  
		c+=1

func find_window(parent: Node) -> Array:
	var windows = []
	
# Check each child of the given parent
	for child in parent.get_children():
		if "focus_mode" in child :
			if child.focus_mode != 0:
				if child.visible == true:
					windows.append(child)
		if child is HBoxContainer and child.visible == true:
			windows += find_window(child)
	return windows



```
So right now despite accesskit enabled, getting to certain modules is nearly impossible via keyboard navigation only.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a tab container
Create 1 Hbox container as a child of tab container
Add 5 buttons to the hbox, with at least one character in each button
Run project
Press the first button, then press right arrow key
OR
Import project
Run project
Press button 1, press right arrow key

Expected: Focus goes to the second button in the HBOX container
Results: Focus goes to the tabbar
